description: Show a node through its index: the notes agents keep about what is under it (KEY<TAB>description). It is a view, not the facts: entries can be missing or stale; for the real contents use ls or json_ls. What an index says about one node X is in the index of X's parent: {"path": "kb", "key": "app.json"} (not path kb/app.json). First line "[index] WHERE, N entries" names the index read. An entry may also carry "index": a path to another index, shown as a third column "index: PATH"; an _index inside a JSON file may itself be such a path string, shown as "[index link] ...". These are not followed: to read one, call again with {"index": PATH}. A relative path there counts from what holds that index, as if it were a folder: _index.json from its folder; an _index from the JSON object it sits in (a name goes one key down, .. goes to the outer object, and .. from the top object leaves the file to its folder). A path starting with #/ is not relative: it counts from the root of the JSON file the index sits in (an _index.json is that file), however deep the index is. The PATH shown is already joined. A key joins back to a path as DIR/KEY (folder) or FILE#/KEY, FILE#/POINTER/KEY (json). An entry is KEY: {"description": "..."}; to change one, edit the place on the [index] line with json_set / json_add / json_del, e.g. json_set {"path": "kb/_index.json#/app.json", "value": {"description": "App settings"}}.

path.description: the node to look at: a folder, FILE, or FILE#/POINTER (written like the json tools); shows the index at its natural place (the index key inside _metainfo first, then the separate _index laid over it: on the same key _index wins; a broken _metainfo is skipped with a note on the first line). Relative paths start at your workspace.

index.description: one index table to read (FILE or FILE#/POINTER, pointing at the table itself, or at an _index that is a path string: then only that path is shown), e.g. your own view. Alone: only this one. With path: laid over the natural index, its entries win on the same key.

key.description: show only this entry (the key exactly as written in the index, no patterns)

offset.description: start at this entry (for the next page)

limit.description: at most this many entries (default: env AOS_JSON_MAX_ITEMS, else 200)
